name: nginx-multisite
description: Provisions Nginx as a reverse proxy with multi-virtual-host support, per-site SSL termination using self-signed certificates, security hardening headers, gzip compression, UFW firewall, Fail2ban intrusion prevention, SSH hardening, and kernel sysctl tuning for three subdomains.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures a dual in-memory caching layer with Memcached and Redis (port 6379, password-authenticated), including a workaround to strip deprecated directives from the generated Redis config file.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a full-stack FastAPI Python web application by installing system dependencies, cloning the app from GitHub, creating a virtualenv, configuring PostgreSQL with a dedicated user and database, and registering the application as a systemd service running under Uvicorn.
